cards.card_text: Then there will be ___ and lamentation.
cards.verse_text: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
cards.snippet: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.

cards.card_text: After swallowing up Israel and her palaces and destroying her strongholds, the Lord has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
cards.verse_text: He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
cards.snippet: He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.

cards.card_text: Lamentation and mourning and woe Praise and thanksgiving and joy Laws and statutes and decrees
cards.verse_text: And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
cards.snippet: And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.

cards.card_text: A lamentation A battle cry A victory song
cards.verse_text: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:
cards.snippet: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:

cards.card_text: The LORD says He will turn their feasts into mourning and their songs into lamentation.
cards.verse_text: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation.
cards.snippet: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation.

cards.card_text: In that day, people will take up a proverb against them and taunt them with a bitter lamentation.
cards.verse_text: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined!
cards.snippet: …take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined!
